status: Final r3 ARM64 measured; Intel startup limitation, no verified Intel gameplay
method: Controlled visible native window; 1440 by 900 content pixels; selected graphics preset (recorded per phase). Incidental movement/fire/look input blocked only during performance phases; Escape still pauses. Invulnerability prevents benchmark deaths. Lobby keeps normal spawns; stage and round-25 stress use explicit debug setup. These are controlled performance measurements, not survival achievements.
metric_distinction: renderedFps counts rendered frames. frameIntervalMs describes requestAnimationFrame display callbacks, not rendered-frame-time percentiles. A small count/window boundary offset can report slightly above the configured 60 FPS cap.
scope: Actual ZIP-extracted r3 packaged 1.8.0 ARM64 executable, visible native window, Laptop preset. Short controlled phases on the current iMac; no physical MacBook, Intel hardware, thermal, battery, prolonged-session or audio-listening claim.
interpretation: Lobby measured after a 15-second warmup with six active enemies; powered stage has no enemies; stress uses an explicitly controlled round-25 setup with 24 active zombies.

Invulnerability/debug setup are benchmark assistance, not survival achievements. Stage/stress use the recorded fixed view; the active-enemy count does not mean every enemy is visible. This is not a worst-case crowd benchmark.
The 1440x900 CSS viewport at display density 2 renders a 1414x883 picture in Laptop mode. The HUD and menu remain native-resolution text.
Do not compare these Laptop values directly with previous Balanced releases as evidence of an equivalent-quality speedup.
